title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $610 on the Roborock Saros 20 robot vacuum and mop
excerpt: Now is your chance to grab it for less than $1,000.
content_html:
SAVE OVER $600: As of Nov. 20, the Roborock Saros 20 robot vacuum and mop has hit a new low price of $989.99 in Amazon's Black Friday sale. That's $610 off its full price of $1,599.99.

Credit: Roborock

$989.99 at Amazon
$1,599.99 Save $610

With the holidays fast approaching, it can feel stressful keeping on top of cleaning before guests arrive. If your floors are a big worry, a robot vacuum can help take some of the pressure off.

Now is a great time to buy a robot vacuum, with tons of deals popping up in Amazon's Black Friday sale. That includes the Roborock Saros 20 robot vacuum and mop, which has hit a record low price on Amazon. As of Nov. 20, this robot vacuum has been marked down to $989.99 as part of the seasonal sale. Normally it's priced at $1,599.99, so this deal saves you a whopping $610 overall.

The best tech deal this week

The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile

The Roborock Saros 20 is powerful, boasting 36,000 Pa of suction for vacuuming, with a dual anti-tangle system that helps ensure hair doesn't get wrapped up in it while scooting around. The RockDock is helpful for mopping, offering 212°F hot-water washing and 131°F hot-air drying to keep pads fresh and clean for scrubbing. Plus, the robot vacuum has a slim build that can move under furniture as low as 3.13 inches off the ground.

It also features an AdaptiLift Chassis 3.0 system, which can lift the vacuum over thresholds and uneven floors (for example, crossing up to 3.46-inch double-layer steps or cleaning carpets up to 1.18 inches deep), as well as the StarSight Autonomous System 2.0. This maps out your home, but also assists with obstacle avoidance. Mashable's Leah Stodart was impressed by this, writing in her review, "I think this is the first time a robot vacuum in my apartment has had a 100 percent obstacle avoidance rate for multiple days on end."
